name: olio.pb.composition
label: Composition
description: PictureBook V3 §8 composition: the structured scene plan that replaces the scene's bare sdPrompt - what the picture is for (purpose), where it is (location/variant or free settingText), what happens and how it feels (action/mood copied from the scene at compose time), how the camera frames it (shotType/viewpoint/focalActor/cameraText), loose props, and the per-composition overrides (configOverride as sparse JSON, promptOverride + promptLocked). Actors and elements are child rows (olio.pb.sceneActor / olio.pb.sceneElement) keyed by their 'composition' FK, never a list on this record. Rows live in the book's group, owned by the request user, one per scene for SCENE/CHAPBOOK_PAGE and one per book for COVER/TITLE_PAGE/CHAPTER_OPENER/SERIES_ART. Deleted with the book by PbDeleteUtil (element -> actor -> composition). No field carries a schema default (PB2 convention rule 3, TestPbModelSchema): the enum columns read NULL as UNKNOWN, booleans materialise false, revision reads 0 on legacy rows.

fields.name: scene
fields.description: The scene this composition plans; set for SCENE and CHAPBOOK_PAGE, null for cover/title/opener/series art.

fields.name: location
fields.description: The resolved location (§7); nullable - a composition with none renders from settingText alone.

fields.name: locationVariant
fields.description: The location realization (time of day / weather / season) in effect; nullable.

fields.name: settingText
fields.description: Free-text setting used when no location is linked, or to add to the linked one.

fields.name: action
fields.description: What happens in the frame; copied from the scene at compose time and editable here without touching the scene.

fields.name: mood
fields.description: Emotional tone of the frame; copied from the scene at compose time.

fields.name: viewpoint
fields.description: Camera angle. An enum here; olio.pb.locationVariant.viewpoint is free text.

fields.name: focalActor
fields.description: The actor the camera is on; one of this composition's own sceneActor rows, nullable.

fields.name: cameraText
fields.description: Free-text camera direction beyond shotType/viewpoint (lens, motion, framing notes).

fields.name: props
fields.description: Loose props as text, for things not worth an olio.pb.sceneElement row.

fields.name: configOverride
fields.description: Sparse JSON of olio.sd.config fields this composition overrides on top of the effective book/style config (§5 precedence).

fields.name: promptOverride
fields.description: A user-authored prompt that replaces the composed one when promptLocked is true.

fields.name: promptLocked
fields.description: When true the composer leaves promptOverride alone and renders it verbatim.

fields.name: userEdited
fields.description: True once a user has edited any field after the composer wrote it; a recompose must not silently overwrite.

fields.name: revision
fields.description: Bumped on every composer write or user save; reads 0 on legacy rows.
